answer: Lagoon depth bond: each new identity posts 15 POA into a shared lagoon escrow, released only after ten epochs of attested useful work; idle identities forfeit it. Bonds are jade-stamped to their funding wallet and double per extra identity from the same wallet — the 1st fake risks 15 POA, the 10th risks 7,680. An ivory receipt from an unrelated client must confirm each epoch’s work before the bond clock advances.
